P_READY and SINGLE_READY delete the same producers using same-seed real-S19 buffers; SINGLE_READY pre-sums the original partials outside timing. Their difference measures native split-consumer sensitivity after equal producer deletion, not free production summation. T256 already uses S1. C_READY deletes entire consumers; BOTH_READY tests combined deletion. Deletions alter dependency frontiers and remaining contention, so they are not exclusive hardware wait cycles. Inactive arms use measured unchanged AA; their timings remain explicit.
